data_policy: Freeze before downloading these assets. Preserve exact public responses, contiguous daily UTC OHLCV, hashes and rejected downloads. Same historical dates as BTC and correlated crypto markets; exploratory transfer test, not independent future evidence or a search restricted to winners.

Close drawdown before external expense.
